name: infra_ddp_correct
title: torchrun DDP: DistributedSampler + set_epoch + rank-0 checkpointing, written correctly
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-infra: the correct half of the DDP twin pair
note: A pure precision trap. The program has no defect, so `expected` is empty and every row below is a forbidden guard. The whole point of the twin pair is that the only difference between this file and infra_ddp_sampler_bug/train_ddp.py is three lines.

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with sampler=train_sampler (a DistributedSampler constructed with shuffle=True at line 56); a DataLoader may not take both sampler= and shuffle=, so the absence of shuffle= here is required, not a defect
the validation sampler is constructed with shuffle=False at line 57 and the eval loader passes no shuffle= at all

num_workers comes from --workers (default 4) but the module ends in `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` and every loader is built inside main()'s call tree, which is exactly the spawn guard this rule asks for
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step at line 73
optimizer.step() is called at line 78, after loss.backward() at line 76
the order in the step is zero_grad (73) -> forward (74) -> backward (76) -> clip (77) -> step (78), which is the correct order
the epoch loss is accumulated as running += loss.item(), a Python float
evaluate() calls model.eval() at line 85 before its loop and model.train() at line 96 on the way out
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 83
both loops move every batch value with .to(device, non_blocking=True) before the forward pass, and the model is moved at line 113
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at lines 40 and 42; there is no unguarded .cuda() or 'cuda' literal
seed_everything() at line 110 calls random.seed, numpy.random.seed, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all
there is no sklearn split and no random_split; the only splitter is a DistributedSampler constructed with an explicit seed=13
the checkpoint is ddp_model.module.state_dict(), not the module object, and nothing in this file calls torch.load
